"What were you mining? Was there a survey?"
"Who left you here? What company?"
"I can take you to my own colony. I could use honest workers."

"I can't transport you now, but I promise I'll be back."

"Um. It's another ion storm! Comms uh, breaking up..."
"Sorry, I have urgent business to attend to."
"You do what you need to do to make a living, I understand."
"That's a good attitude, you have to accept your place in the world."
"That's outrageous! They left you to die out here!"

"What are you doing on this... rock?"
"Are you pirates?"
"So who's this Fenius?"
"So who's this Marlowe?"
"It's 'Luddic Faithful', not 'Luddie."
"Tell me about Old Marlowe's treasure."
Offer to transport them... to prison
"About going to prison? I'm telling you, not asking."
Offer to transport them to a pirate world
Offer to transport them to a pirate world (lie)

"Not at all, I'm sure."
"Yuck."
"Then it's a deal."
"I'll deal with Fenius as I see fit."
"How do I know I can trust you?"
"I'll think about it."
"So you're... honest pirates."
"So you're pirates."
"So you're not pirates."
"This one." (prepare a raid)
"Mind your tone. I'm the one with warships in orbit."
"Yes, I will require that you live in accordance with Luddic principles."
"No, my crew is free to practice their own beliefs. Or lack thereof."
"Yes, yes... I'll send shuttles down to pick you up." (prepare the brig)
"Good. I'll have shuttles sent down."
"Unfortunately, I don't have enough room."
"I'm reconsidering my options."
Shuttle the marooned pirates to $name
No, tell them it'll be the next stop at a suitable port.

Inquire about turning a crew of pirates over to official custody
"An agent of the Church hired me to find you."
"I shall bring word of you to my contact, to the Church."
"I could bring word of you to my contact, to the Church..."
"What are you doing out on the fringe?"
"How can you crawl back to the Church when there is a Path more righteous?"
"You have strayed far, $brotherOrSister, but the Church is rich in mercy"
"How many of you need transport?"
"Can you pay for passage?"
Offer to transport them to a Luddic Church world
Transport them to a Luddic Church world, for forgiveness
Transport them to the Luddic Path, to start anew
Leave them for the Church to deal with.
Make an excuse and cut the comms
"I see. That is an unfortunate course of events."
"I'm afraid that this all sounds like brazen heresy."
"So you rubes got tricked until someone did the sensible thing and murdered the conman."
"You're far from the true Path. Thank Ludd what had to be done was done."
"I take no pleasure in observing that your faith blinded you."
"It's a good thing someone finally stood up and murdered the scum, eh?"
"Know that I follow the Path. It may well lead not where the Church preaches."
"You have a question?"
"The Church will tend to its flock."
"I don't know what the Church intends, if that is what you wanted to ask."
"I don't know what the Church intends, if that is what you wish to ask."
"Truly, I don't know what the Church intends."
"I could only assume so. Heresy is a serious crime."
"Yes, I will take you to the Path. There you will discover true faith."
"No, we're just discussing faith. Just words."
